title: More Proverbs of Solomon

questions.question: These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah did what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:1 (ESV): "These also are proverbs of Solomon which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied."

questions.question: It is the glory of God to conceal things, but the glory of kings is to search things what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:2 (ESV): "but the glory of kings is to search things out."

questions.question: Take away the dross from the silver, and the smith has material for a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:4 (ESV): "and the smith has material for a vessel;"

questions.question: Do not put yourself forward in the king's presence or stand in the place of the what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:6 (ESV): "or stand in the place of the great,"

questions.question: If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat, and if he is thirsty, give him water to what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:21 (ESV): "and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink,"

questions.question: For you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:22 (ESV): "and the Lord will reward you."

questions.question: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in a setting of what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:11 (ESV): "is like apples of gold in a setting of silver."

questions.question: Like a golden earring or an ornament of fine gold is a wise reprover to a listening what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:12 (ESV): "is a wise reprover to a listening ear."

questions.question: Like the cold of snow in the time of harvest is a faithful messenger to those who send him; he refreshes the soul of his what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:13 (ESV): "he refreshes the soul of his masters."

questions.question: With patience a ruler may be persuaded, and a soft tongue will break a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:15 (ESV): "and a soft tongue will break a bone."

questions.question: Take away the wicked from the presence of the king, and his throne will be established in what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:5 (ESV): "and his throne will be established in righteousness."

questions.question: Like clouds and wind without rain is a man who boasts of a gift he does not what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:14 (ESV): "is a man who boasts of a gift he does not give."

questions.question: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor's house, lest he have his fill of you and do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:17 (ESV): "lest he have his fill of you and hate you."

questions.question: Like a moth in clothing or a worm in wood is sorrow in the heart of a what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:20 (Using the KJV/other translations imagery, but checking ESV). ESV 25:20: "Whoever sings songs to a heavy heart is like one who takes off a garment on a cold day, and like vinegar on soda." Wait, "moth in clothing" is not 25:20. Let's find a better question. 25:28: "A man without self-control is like a city broken into and left without walls."

questions.question: A man without self-control is like a city broken into and left without what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:28 (ESV): "A man without self-control is like a city broken into and left without walls."

questions.question: If you have found honey, eat only enough for you, lest you have your fill of it and do what?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 25:16 (ESV): "lest you have your fill of it and vomit it."

key_verse_text: If your enemy is hungry, give him bread to eat, and if he is thirsty, give him water to drink, for you will heap burning coals on his head, and the Lord will reward you.
